newsitem.title: CHINA: China Eastern Airlines to list in HK, New York.
newsitem.headline: China Eastern Airlines to list in HK, New York.

text.p: China Eastern Airlines will list in New York and Hong Kong simultaneously at the beginning of 1997, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
China Eastern would be the first Chinese carrier to issue shares overseas, the news agency said.
Xinhua did not say if China Eastern had received listing approval from the Hong Kong and New York stock exchanges.
China Southern Airlines would follow suit, Xinhua quoted an official of the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) as saying.
The shares listed overseas would not be more than 35 percent of the carriers' registered capital, Xia Xinghua, a CAAC department director said.
"It shows China has made a step further in opening up its civil aviation market by expanding the source of overseas investment," Xia said.
China Eastern would also issue a small number of A shares -- shares that can be traded only by Chinese citizens -- on the domestic market after the overseas listing, Xinhua said.
"Other carriers in China may do the same if the listing of the two airlines are proved successful," Xia said.
The agency gave no further details on the planned listings.
